_comment: Page copy for /g/uk-it-growth, taken word for word from the IT board v56 (Claude Design). {THRESHOLD}, {OFFER} and {WORTH} are filled from config.json at build time. Do not edit a sentence to fit a layout; change the board first. The build refuses dashes, exclamation marks, American spellings and a commission rate (see scripts/build-g-growth.mjs). Changed 26 Oct 2026 by the owner (workshop with Sondre, the new lead rules): fit.no[0] and outcomes.not-a-fit.p now say that firms from £1m, or younger than two years, qualify with £1,000 or more a month on marketing. The board is not updated yet.

meta.title: Elevate Marketing for UK IT services firms
meta.description: Sales conversations for UK IT services firms, from campaigns we run. A few questions to see whether we would take you on.

topline: For UK IT services firms with {THRESHOLD}+ turnover
cta: See whether we would take you on

hero.h1a: We have filled the pipeline for IT consultancies before.
hero.h1b: Here is what it looked like.

ingress.t: Ignite Consulting, Be | Shaping the Future and Crux IT Consulting.
between them, from campaigns we ran. If you are growing and want more of the right conversations, this is the work we do.

hero.micro: A few questions. We only take on firms we think we can help.

cases.note: Close rate is the share of qualified leads each client reported as won. Figures from each client's own records. Named and published with each client's written permission.

fit.h2: This is for firms that are growing, not firms that are stuck.
fit.body: The firms we work best with already win work through referrals and reputation. What they lack is a second channel that brings in the same kind of client, predictably, without the partners doing all the selling.
yes: You run a UK IT services firm with {THRESHOLD} or more in turnover and at least two years of trading, or with £1m or more and a marketing budget of £1,000 a month
A new client is worth {WORTH} or more to you in the first year
You have a sales function, even if that is a founder, that can respond within two working days
You have capacity to take on new clients in the next three months
no: You turn over less than £1m, or you are below {THRESHOLD} or newer than two years and spend under £1,000 a month on marketing
You sell products or software licences rather than services
You need leads to get through the next quarter
You want leads without anyone to follow them up
fit.note: We check the details you give after you apply, and we confirm turnover with you on the call.

pay.h2: Paid when a deal closes. Our incentives are the same as yours.
pay.body: No retainer, no setup fee, no minimum term. We invoice a commission on deals that close from campaigns we run. The rate depends on what a client is worth to you, so we agree it before anything runs. It is not published, because it is not the same for two firms.
open: A sale is a signed contract or purchase order with a new client that came from a lead our campaigns produced. Existing clients, and clients that came from elsewhere, do not count.
Your own CRM is the record. Each month you confirm which closed deals came from our campaigns, and we invoice only those.
We invoice monthly, for deals that closed that month. Payment terms are 14 days.
If nothing closes, we invoice nothing.
The advertising budget is separate. You pay it to the platforms directly, and we agree it with you before anything runs.

keep.h2: Your accounts. Your data. Your sales team.

items.p: Campaigns run in ad accounts you own. You pay the platforms directly, with no markup from us.
Leads, results and sales are tracked in your own CRM. If we stop working together, you keep all of it.
We do not replace your sales team. We fill their calendar with conversations that fit.

meeting.body: We do not pitch. We sit down with your numbers and work out what it would take to reach next year's target.

steps.p: You tell us your turnover, your target for next year, and what a typical new client is worth.
We confirm four numbers together: last year's turnover, next year's target, what a new client is worth in year one, and how many sales meetings turn into clients.
You receive a one page sheet with the arithmetic: new clients per month needed, sales meetings per month that requires, and how that compares with your pipeline today.

meeting.closing: You keep the sheet whether or not we work together. It contains your numbers only. No quote, no commission rate, no promise.

items.q: Will this work at our size?
items.a: The mechanism is the same: a clear offer, a clear buyer, and campaigns tracked to closed deals. What changes with size is the budget and the sales cycle, and we plan for both on the first call.

items.q: How is this different from an agency on a retainer?
items.a: A retainer is paid whether or not anything closes. Our invoice depends on a deal closing, so we only earn when your sales team does.
You do. We work inside them. If we stop, they stay with you.
No. We can show you what we have done, the arithmetic and the method. We cannot promise a number of meetings or deals.

items.q: What if we want to stop?
items.a: There is no minimum term. You can stop with 30 days' notice, and you keep the accounts and the data.

footer.text: Elevate Marketing is operated by EngeCo AS, Norwegian organisation no. 924 490 926, Midtfjellet 66, 5363 Ågotnes, Norway.

form.heading: See whether we would take you on
form.under: A few questions. We only take on firms we think we can help.
form.cta: See whether we would take you on
form.sending: Checking a few details. This takes a few seconds.
form.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Your answers are still here. Please try again, or email
form.consent: We use your details to reply to this application, to arrange a call and to keep a record of it. We contact you by email, and by text message if you give us a mobile number. If you tell us you are at capacity, we will get back in touch once, in three months.

book.h: Thank you. Choose a time that suits you.
book.p: Pick a slot for a {OFFER}. Your own numbers are all we need.
book.small: No time that works? Reply to the confirmation email and we will find one.

takk.p: We will send a confirmation and a short note on what to have to hand: last year's turnover, next year's target, and what a typical new client is worth.

review.h: Thank you. We will be in touch within one working day.
review.p: We want to check a few details before we suggest a time.

not-now.h: Thank you. Come back when you have capacity.
not-now.p: If you are at capacity now, we will ask again in three months.

not-a-fit.h: Thank you. This is not the right fit at the moment.
not-a-fit.p: We work with UK IT services firms that turn over £1m or more, where a new client is worth £10k or more in the first year. Below {THRESHOLD}, or with less than two years of trading, we ask for a marketing budget of £1,000 or more a month. If that changes, we would be glad to hear from you.
not-a-fit.note: If we have misread your answers, email {EMAIL} and we will look again.

interest.h: Looking for a new website instead?
interest.p: If you would like a fixed-price quote for a new website, or a monthly retainer for your marketing, press the button and we will email you once, within two working days. A person at Elevate Marketing also reads every application, and may email you once about this if we think it could suit your firm. Every email says how to say no.
interest.done: Thank you. We will email you from {EMAIL} within two working days.
interest.error: That did not go through. Email {EMAIL} and ask for a quote, and we will send one.
interest.noscript: To ask for a quote on a new website, email {EMAIL}.
